==About==

{{i|Pumpkin Gnochi}} must be prepared on a {{i|Baking Table}}. When preparing Foods at a Baking Table there is a chance to receive a {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}}. Preparing Foods on a Baking Table removes a small amount of [[Insanity]]. Pumpkin Gnochi is [[Gluttony#Double Variable Recipe|Double Variable Recipe]].
